about: Source list for the CLOSURES SUPER-BOT (kpc_closures_bot.py, RULE SHEET D). One row per page or feed: area (US-XX / CA-XX / 'US' for every state), agency, url, kind ('feed' = machine-readable, 'page' = read as text, 'pdf' = read by range), how (a reader name in the bot, or 'generic'), scope ('state' = state parks and WMAs only, 'federal' = federal units only, 'all'). The 49 pages of KPC-Links data/closure-pages.json are read too (loaded by the bot, not copied here) with how 'generic'. Chat 8 adds rows here; the bot lists a page once. Pages that block robots are reported 'robots' and never worked around.

sources.note: Kentucky's own reader (kpc_park_alerts.py) reads the same list; CL-5: that reader wins until Brandon's GO
SharePoint list: each alert is a link to its own page; the link text is the notice
quota-hunt calendar: HUNT items (closed to non-hunters on the dates)
Georgia sheet GA1-GA4: 'Updated m/d/yy' = the agency date; vehicles-only = note; lease ended = 'may not be public land now'
GA4: quota hunts read like Kentucky's
also in closure-pages.json; listed here so a PDF list linked from it is read by range (CL-7)
